name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.81 / build 82 uses the SMAPE/MAPE PDF templates, adds the student/non-student Medical Info Form selector and optional 1x1 form photo, and moves Medical Records History into the Records workspace. Staff-chat feedback stays inside the conversation with optional rating and comment. The matching private medical-form backend is live. Existing saved forms and conversations are preserved; no data reset or database-rule deployment is included. Existing development/test signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval. Install over a compatible existing app without uninstalling or clearing app data. Physical-phone installation and actual patient push delivery were not verified.
